newsitem.title: UK: FTSE 100 opens lower in sympathy with gilts.
newsitem.headline: FTSE 100 opens lower in sympathy with gilts.

text.p: The FTSE 100, having closed on a fresh peak on Friday, eased at the open in line with a softer UK government bond (gilts) market ahead of what is expected to be a light and listless trading session, dealers said on Monday.
"We saw a good performance on Friday. The market has a good undertone to it. This is not the time of year when institutions want to let go of shares," said one dealer.
The leading blue chip index was down 7.5 points at 4,070.1 at 0844 GMT, after having climbed as high as 4,100 on Friday before easing back in tandem with Wall Street.
